_note: x402 endpoint catalog. Discovery is substring/keyword match over `name`, `description`, `tags`. `method` is GET or POST (case-insensitive). For POST/PUT/PATCH, `body_template` is sent as an application/json body. `{subject}` / `{token}` in `url` or in any string value of `body_template` is replaced with the token the user asked about. `cost_usd` is the expected price shown at confirmation; the real price comes from the 402 response and is capped at `cost_usd * 1.5`. VERIFY each endpoint's method + body shape against its live 402 challenge before a real-money demo — these were sourced from the CDP x402 Bazaar (via x402scan) and their contracts can change.

endpoints.name: Token Risk Score
endpoints.description: Rug-pull and honeypot risk assessment for an ERC-20 on Base: mint authority, LP lock, holder concentration, transfer tax, sniper wallets.

endpoints.name: Whale Flows
endpoints.description: Recent large transfers and net accumulation/distribution for a token, by wallet cohort, plus holder and market context.

endpoints.name: Smart Money Positioning
endpoints.description: What consistently-profitable wallets are buying and selling right now on Base, plus market-wide news and macro context.

endpoints.name: Token Price & Liquidity
endpoints.description: Spot price, 24h volume, and pool liquidity depth for a Base token.
